articleTitle: Load balancing in fog networks using digital twins
publicationTitle: IET International Conference on Engineering Technologies and Applications (ICETA 2024)
abstract: The emergence of fog computing bridges the gap between cloud functionalities and end devices in the traditional cloud computing architecture, enabling services to be deployed closer to the users. Unfortunately, the inherent environmental differences, the heterogeneity of fog nodes, and the spatiotemporal variation in service demands from devices create a load imbalance among fog nodes. This study proposes a fog computing architecture that integrates digital twin and reinforcement learning technologies, aiming to implement a task offloading strategy to promote load balancing within fog networks. Through digital twin technology, the load of fog nodes can be monitored and predicted in real-time, while reinforcement learning is tasked with making appropriate task offloading decisions. The results confirm that this method effectively facilitates load balancing in fog networks.

articleTitle: Improved dye-sensitized solar cells incorporating hydrangea-shaped scattering layer
publicationTitle: IET International Conference on Engineering Technologies and Applications (ICETA 2024)
abstract: This study used hydrothermal synthesis to synthesize hydrangea-shaped titanium dioxide nanoparticles and applied them to the scattering layer of dye-sensitized solar cells (DSSCs). Our experimental results demonstrate that a suitable mixture of small and large particles for the light-scattering layers can enhance the conversion efficiency of DSSCs.

articleTitle: Based on artificial intelligence image recognition technology for robotic arm
publicationTitle: IET International Conference on Engineering Technologies and Applications (ICETA 2024)
abstract: In this paper, the robot arm image recognition was conducted by teachable machine to create models within OpenVINO quantification to achieve well identification. The system experimental hardware development contained six-axis collaborative Robotic Arm, Intel NCU12WSHi5 and network camera. The paper also described the robotic arm and teachable machine training, OpenVINO quantification, and image recognition in different object to make the image recognition more effective. The Teachable Machine learning by OpenVINO can speed learning model within a convergence time.

articleTitle: Develop a victim detection model in rescue operations using thermal camera and Jetson computing platform
publicationTitle: IET International Conference on Engineering Technologies and Applications (ICETA 2024)
abstract: In emergency situations such as fires or natural disasters, the swift and accurate search and detection of victims are crucia l for saving lives and minimizing damage. However, in low-light conditions, this becomes particularly challenging due to limited visibility. This research utilizes the Yolov8 neural network architecture trained on a custom-created database, combined with thermal cameras and the Jetson Orin embedded computing platform, to develop a model for human detection in low-light environments. Experimental results show that the model operates stably, capable of distinguishing humans from other thermal objects. Additionally, the ability to count the number of people within the captured frame enables the system to meet practical needs in rescue operations.

articleTitle: A 5 Gb/s receiver with decision feedback equalizer and baud-rate clock and data recovery circuit for 8K displays in 90 nm CMOS process
publicationTitle: IET International Conference on Engineering Technologies and Applications (ICETA 2024)
abstract: This paper presents a receiver (Rx) applied for an 8K display with 8-bit color and 60 FPS, and required a data transmission speed of 48 Gb/s. As ten driver ICs used by the 8k display, the transmission speed of each driver IC must achieve 4.8 Gb/s. While compensating for 8.7-dB channel loss, the proposed Rx of the driver IC operates at a transmission speed of 5Gb/s with a power consumption of 42.91 mW.

articleTitle: Using coordinated PV inverters control for voltage regulation in microgrid
publicationTitle: IET International Conference on Engineering Technologies and Applications (ICETA 2024)
abstract: With the huge integration of PV Power generations into electric grids it causes the voltage fluctuation that cannot be ignored. To mitigate this problem, it is possible to seek the utilization of inverter-based resources with specific controls in microgrid. Therefore, this paper proposes a coordinated PV inverters control that combines traditional Voltage/Var control and grid-forming control for voltage regulation in microgrid system. A distribution system level AC microgrid with several PV installations is modelled; simulation scenarios under individual, uncoordinated, and coordinated implementation of PV inverters are used to validate he performance of proposed voltage regulation method.

articleTitle: AI-assisted design education: boosting rapid prototyping skills in design students
publicationTitle: IET International Conference on Engineering Technologies and Applications (ICETA 2024)
abstract: This study investigates the integration of AI Agent technology in interactive design education, emphasizing rapid prototyping and interdisciplinary learning. It underscores the growing significance of machine learning in design and production as AI continues to advance. The research explores innovative teaching scenarios, content design, and varying levels of difficulty, with a focus on practical tasks and the latest AI applications. The findings reveal that AI Agent assistance significantly boosts student motivation and participation, as evidenced by IMI questionnaire scores above the median. Students reported finding AI Agents particularly beneficial, achieving high marks and greater confidence. This confirms the positive impact of AI Agents on digital-assisted learning and their value as tools for self-learning, ultimately enhancing educational efficiency.

articleTitle: The impact of green marketing communication and green purchasing
publicationTitle: IET International Conference on Engineering Technologies and Applications (ICETA 2024)
abstract: Green consumption has become an irreversible global trend, with more and more brands actively engaging in green production and marketing activities to meet market demand and fulfil social responsibility. This study aims to explore the influence of consumers' environmental commitment, discount value, brand image, influencer impact, and green marketing communication on green purchase intention, with a particular focus on the moderating role of product involvement.

articleTitle: A hybrid flash and incremental analog-to-digital converter for telemedicine applications
publicationTitle: IET International Conference on Engineering Technologies and Applications (ICETA 2024)
abstract: This paper proposes a hybrid architecture of wide bandwidth and high-resolution analog-to-digital converter. It is a switched- capacitor incremental analog-to-digital converter composed of a flash analog-to-digital converter for obtaining a high- performance converter. By optimizing the conversion clock number and the system order, the proposed converter can be implemented by a 180-nm 1P6M CMOS process. It could achieve an SNDR of 72.36-dB and ENOB of 11.7-bit with a bandwidth of 25-MHz, demonstrating its high performance and reliability, which should provide a sense of confidence in its potential applications in telemedicine and industrial detecting.

articleTitle: Stability analysis of a DC microgrid fed to a multimachine power system using a compressed air energy storage system
publicationTitle: IET International Conference on Engineering Technologies and Applications (ICETA 2024)
abstract: This paper presents the stability analysis of a DC microgrid (MG) connected to a multimachine power system (MMPS) using a compressed air energy storage (CAES) system. The proposed CAES connected at the bus where the DC MG is connected to the MMPS compensates for the intermittent energy generated by the DC MG that has a biomass farm based on a microturbine and a solar farm based on a solar array. In this study, Matlab/Simulink is used to establish the complete system model. The simulation results show that power smoothing and stability improvement of the studied system can be simultaneously achieved by using the proposed CAES.

articleTitle: Rapid development of IIoT control systems using Volapu IIoT suite: a smart irrigation case study
publicationTitle: IET International Conference on Engineering Technologies and Applications (ICETA 2024)
abstract: This paper investigates the application of Industrial IoT (IIoT) systems for rapid development and deployment of control systems. We present a case study of a smart plant irrigation system implemented using Volapu IIoT Suite, highlighting its advantages for low-cost and rapid development. The system leverages real-time sensor data (soil moisture, temperature) for rule-based control with the option to integrate weather forecasts for more informed decision-making. Volapu’s data interface enables the future incorporation of advanced data processing modules, facilitating the construction of higher-order control models. This study demonstrates the effectiveness of Volapu IIoT Suite in facilitating the development of cost-effective and scalable IIoT control systems.

articleTitle: Optimizing film sound post-production: leveraging AI-powered repair assistant in educational settings
publicationTitle: IET International Conference on Engineering Technologies and Applications (ICETA 2024)
abstract: Learning film sound post-production involves acquiring sound knowledge, software training, and field recording experience to handle sound issues. Challenges in teaching include limited equipment and lengthy skill development. This study proposes using Digital Audio Workstation (DAW) software Nuendo [1] and iZotope RX [2] with AI for teaching. Results show reduced training time and improved issue detection repair accuracy, boosting student success rates. This method integrates digital tools and AI, offering an efficient pathway to mastering film sound post-production enhancing, learning outcomes, and skills in this specialized domain.

articleTitle: Unveiling the intelligence mechanisms behind optical illusions
publicationTitle: IET International Conference on Engineering Technologies and Applications (ICETA 2024)
abstract: Optical illusions, despite their deceptive appearance, offer profound insights into the mechanisms of human intelligence. This paper explores the intricate relationship between intelligence and optical illusions, elucidating how cognitive processes, neural mechanisms, and perceptual biases contribute to the generation and interpretation of illusory phenomena. By dissecting the underlying intelligence mechanisms, we uncover the complex interplay between perception, cognition, and the human brain, shedding light on the fundamental principles of intelligent behavior.

articleTitle: Design of a colour perception monitoring system for signal lights in industrial automation based on IoT technology
publicationTitle: IET International Conference on Engineering Technologies and Applications (ICETA 2024)
abstract: With the advancement of industrial automation and smart manufacturing technologies, the demand for precise and efficient monitoring systems in factories has surged to ensure seamless production and consistent product quality. Traditional manual inspections are labour-intensive and time-consuming, often prone to errors or delays due to human factors. To address these challenges, we propose an IoT-based three-color light monitoring system designed to facilitate real-time monitoring of equipment status and enable rapid response to abnormal conditions. This system integrates sensors and cloud technology to continuously monitor environmental conditions and light colour variations, assessing their accuracy in real-time. In the event of equipment anomalies, the system promptly analyses the situation and dispatches alerts via the network to notify relevant personnel for maintenance or operational adjustments. This solution not only mitigates potential losses but also reduces costs and enhances production efficiency by minimizing reliance on manual inspections. By further enhancing the system's functionality and performance, it can meet diverse application needs and promote the integration of industrial automation and IoT.

articleTitle: The utilization of big data analytics and algorithm adjustment on artificial intelligence discussions in Taiwan
publicationTitle: IET International Conference on Engineering Technologies and Applications (ICETA 2024)
abstract: Utilizing big data analytics to predict trends has become an important process in developing marketing strategies. However, the accuracy of big data analytics in predicting results is still a matter of debate. This research employed media big data analytics to measure public opinion on discussions about artificial intelligence (AI), and its impact on stock market changes. It is suggested that big data analytics platforms can be used to identify trending issues and uncover hidden information about marketing trends. However, while big data analytics can be valuable, the algorithms need to be refined to improve their predictive accuracy.

articleTitle: Defect detection of optical microscope images in semiconductor fabrication process based on pre-trained convolution neural network
publicationTitle: IET International Conference on Engineering Technologies and Applications (ICETA 2024)
abstract: This study utilizes three pre-trained convolutional neural network models—GoogleNet, ResNet101, and VGG19—to identify contamination defects of different steps, sizes, and components in the semiconductor fabrication process. Traditionally, these defects could only be recognized manually. The results of this study indicate that the recognition accuracy mostly exceeds 85%. Moreover, the results of Grad-CAM show that the models can accurately identify contaminated areas.

articleTitle: Window-based vision transformer for finger-vein recognition
publicationTitle: IET International Conference on Engineering Technologies and Applications (ICETA 2024)
abstract: In recent years, with the rapid development of the Internet, issues such as personal privacy and identity theft have become the focus of people's concerns. More and more people are paying attention to data encryption, identity recognition, and other security technologies to protect personal privacy. Among them, because fingerprint features are difficult to forge, steal, and wear out, biometric identification technology that uses these biometric features for identification is regarded as an effective alternative to traditional identification technology. However, in current finger vein recognition technology, when the number of parameters is low, the feature extraction ability of the model is easily limited, leading to a decline in the model's recognition ability. To address the above issues, this study proposes a vision transformer model architecture based on a window-based attention block for finger vein recognition. Through this block's multi-head self-attention mechanism (MHSA), the model can effectively extract subtle finger vein features and simultaneously capture the long-range dependence (LAD) between finger vein features, enhancing the model’s ability to identify these features. Experimental results indicate that the finger vein model proposed in this study achieves a CIR of 99.90% on the FV-USM public database, outperforming previous studies.

articleTitle: Advancements in healthcare architecture through 5G technology
publicationTitle: IET International Conference on Engineering Technologies and Applications (ICETA 2024)
abstract: The integration of 5G technology into healthcare architecture represents a significant leap forward in the delivery of medical services. This paper explores the transformative impact of 5G on healthcare architecture, focusing on its potential to enhance remote patient monitoring, telemedicine, IoMT connectivity, edge computing, and emergency response systems. Through an analysis of current developments and future possibilities, this paper elucidates how 5G is reshaping healthcare infrastructure to improve patient outcomes, increase efficiency, and enable innovative medical applications.

articleTitle: Mechanical properties of FeNiCoAlTaB single crystal
publicationTitle: IET International Conference on Engineering Technologies and Applications (ICETA 2024)
abstract: In this study, the microstructure and mechanical property of Fe<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">40.95</sub>Ni<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">28</sub>Co<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">17</sub>Al<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">11.5</sub>Ta<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2.5</sub>B<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0.05</sub>(at.%) SMAs are investigated. Based on the tensile results, the fracture stress is 504 MPa for 600°C-24 H sample and the fracture stress is 724 MPa for 600°C-48 H sample.

articleTitle: Stability analysis of grid-tied wind permanent magnet synchronous generators using an energy storage system based on vanadium redox flow battery
publicationTitle: IET International Conference on Engineering Technologies and Applications (ICETA 2024)
abstract: This paper establishes the mathematical model for an energy storage system (ESS) based on a vanadium redox flow battery (VRFB) connected to the common DC link between the machine-side converter (MSC) and the system-side converter (SSC) of a wind permanent magnet synchronous generator (PMSG)-based wind turbine generator (WTG) through a bidirectional DC/DC converter. Root-loci plots of the studied bidirectional DC/DC converter of the VRFB-ESS with and without the designed damping controller are compared. Comparative dynamic responses of the studied wind PMSG under different wind-speed disturbances are also achieved.

articleTitle: Failure mode analysis of IGBT module for an EV motor controller
publicationTitle: IET International Conference on Engineering Technologies and Applications (ICETA 2024)
abstract: This paper presents failure mode analysis of an IGBT module in an electric vehicle (EV) motor controller. The IGBT module is crucial for converting high-voltage DC power to three-phase AC power for the motor. Various failure modes and their impacts are examined, including permanent shorts, gate pin floating, continuous high gating signals, anomalies in negative DC voltage, overcurrent, overvoltage, and overheating. Understanding these mechanisms is essential for improving the reliability and performance of EV motor controllers, providing insights to enhance design and operational strategies to mitigate failure risks.

articleTitle: Stability improvement of grid-connected wind doubly-fed induction generators using a vanadium redox flow battery-based energy storage system
publicationTitle: IET International Conference on Engineering Technologies and Applications (ICETA 2024)
abstract: This paper focuses on establishing the mathematical model for a vanadium redox flow battery (VRFB)-based energy storage system (ESS) connected to the common DC link between the rotor-side converter (RSC) and the grid-side converter (GSC) of a wind doubly-fed induction generator (DFIG)-based wind turbine generator (WTG) through a bidirectional DC/DC converter. Root-loci plots of the studied bidirectional DC/DC converter of the VRFB-ESS with and without the designed damping controller are compared. Comparative dynamic responses of the studied wind DFIG subject to a wind-speed disturbance are also performed.

articleTitle: Implementation of AI hearing-loss assistive hat
publicationTitle: IET International Conference on Engineering Technologies and Applications (ICETA 2024)
abstract: Although the technology of hearing aids has matured, the major problem faced by hearing-loss people is that they are more sensitive to noise. In noisy environments, the noise is also amplified after the hearing aids have compensated for the sound. This compensation is harsh and unpleasant to the hearing-loss people, leading to their reluctance to wear them. This study realizes an intelligent cap for hearing-loss people, with an intelligent lifting OLED display on the brim, which instantly shows the result of the recognition of the audio captured by the microphone. The effect is similar to the subtitles appearing in the movie, which allows the hearing-loss person to have a better experience when wearing the cap. The low cost of this study and the excellent dialog assistance function can help more disadvantaged hearing-loss people in need of help and effectively improve the quality of life of hearing-loss people.

articleTitle: Application research on optimizing TDMA scheduling strategies in tactical data links using deep reinforcement learning
publicationTitle: IET International Conference on Engineering Technologies and Applications (ICETA 2024)
abstract: Time Division Multiple Access (TDMA) scheduling strategy optimization based on Deep Reinforcement Learning (DRL) for Tactical Digital Information Links (TADIL). Unlike traditional TDMA methods, this investigation focuses on slot allocation adjustment in Mobile Ad-hoc Networks (MANETs) to enhance transmission efficiency and adapt to network dynamics. Through operation cases in radio networks, the proposed method demonstrates its effectiveness in significantly reducing communication delays for high-priority tasks while providing stable data transmission channels for low-priority tasks. Compared to existing methods, our TDMA scheduling strategy shows better adaptability to dynamic data rates while ensuring Quality of Service (QoS).

articleTitle: Development of human neck muscle physical model for rehabilitation verification
publicationTitle: IET International Conference on Engineering Technologies and Applications (ICETA 2024)
abstract: In recent years, prevalence of chronic neck muscle diseases has spurred research into neck rehabilitation machines, yet verification faces significant challenges. The neck's critical role in human anatomy increases the risk of human trials. However, complexity and individual variability of neck muscles makes obtaining biological signals difficult. Existing head-neck models, such as those for car crash simulations, differ greatly from rehabilitation needs. This study aims to develop a biomechanical head-neck model for rehabilitation verification. A virtual model for the neck system was established by using OpenSim supported by biomechanical theories. The complex neck muscle system was linearized from the original virtual model for further analyses and error corrections to achieve a model that can effectively substitute for the real human head-neck.

articleTitle: The prediction of energy liberation on lathe processing applied the gradient boosting regression tree (GBRT)
publicationTitle: IET International Conference on Engineering Technologies and Applications (ICETA 2024)
abstract: It is getting more and more attractive on machine learning which is applied to the prediction. The present study proposes an ensemble learning based on the Gradient Boosting Regression Tree (GBRT) to model the prediction of energy liberation on lathe processing and the potential features which include vibration, temperature, cutting amount, and the roughness of the surface. To implement the optimal GBRT for the prediction, it also studies the hyperparameter such as the quantity of trees, learning rate, and the depth of the tree to the parameter optimization by grid search and k-fold cross validation. Proven by verification and compared to other regression models, GBRT is creditable and precedes other regression models in the prediction of energy liberation on processing over kinds of features input under the limited quantity of the data sample.

articleTitle: BPNN prediction for state of charge lithium-ion battery based on IOT system
publicationTitle: IET International Conference on Engineering Technologies and Applications (ICETA 2024)
abstract: Battery management systems (BMS) of lithium-ion batteries play an significant role in ensuring the safety, reliability and efficiency of Electric Vehicles (EVs) during operation. The state of charge (SoC) prediction is main function of BMS in the battery system. It is necessary to monitor the SoC information of BMS in real-time that can be achieved by internet of thing (IOT) devices. In order to reduce physical parameters computation error and time consumption, the paper proposed the SoC prediction using back-propagation neural network (BPNN) based on IOT embedded system. The results show based on qualitative graph and quantitative model criteria to demonstrate the proposed BPNN model SoC prediction of BMS employs in IOT system provides the better accuracy ability.

articleTitle: The combination of audio-visual content marketing and new communication technology platforms is reflected in young people's favoritism towards product brands, as exemplified by the T. K. Food
publicationTitle: IET International Conference on Engineering Technologies and Applications (ICETA 2024)
abstract: With the continuous advancement of digital technology, audio-visual content marketing plays an increasingly important role in the modern market. In this paper, we will take the example of T. K. Food to explore the impact of the combination of audio-visual content marketing and new communication technologies on young people's favoritism towards product brands.

articleTitle: Fault detection in air pump assembly based on sound classification using one-dimensional convolutional neural networks
publicationTitle: IET International Conference on Engineering Technologies and Applications (ICETA 2024)
abstract: This study presents a comprehensive analysis of the operational audio signals produced by a AC rectified reciprocating air pump under various fault and healthy conditions. A total of 1200 audio data samples, each with a duration of 0.1 seconds, were collected and standardized from ten machines of the same model. These samples encompass six distinct states, including a normal state and five different assembly faults. Utilizing this data, the study investigates the performance of various one-dimensional convolutional neural network (CNN) architectures for audio signal recognition, exploring configurations with different numbers of layers (one to three) and filter sizes (10 to 50). The findings indicate that single-layer CNN architectures are ineffective in accurately identifying the different fault states. Conversely, two-layer CNN architectures, particularly those with filter sizes ranging from 20 to 30, exhibit a recognition accuracy of up to 90% and demonstrate exceptional stability. In contrast, three-layer architectures show poor performance, with a notable occurrence of depth degradation phenomena. These results underscore the importance of selecting an appropriate network depth and filter size to enhance the accuracy of audio signal recognition for air pumps.

articleTitle: Integrating sustainability into ERC-20 token development on Ethereum
publicationTitle: IET International Conference on Engineering Technologies and Applications (ICETA 2024)
abstract: This research presents a detailed exploration of designing and implementing an ERC-20 smart contract on the Ethereum blockchain, with a focused integration of environmental sustainability and ethical considerations. In the context of a growing emphasis on sustainable practices within the digital asset domain, this study evaluates how ERC-20 token development aligns with eco-innovative measures. It highlights token design innovations that mitigate environmental impact, such as energy-efficient consensus mechanisms and integrated carbon offsetting features. Furthermore, the paper comprehensively discusses the ethical dimensions of tokenization, with particular attention to ensuring transparency, enhancing security, and promoting fairness, aiming to ensure that digital assets contribute positively to both the economy and society. By synthesizing these principles, the proposed ERC-20 smart contract framework seeks to establish standards for responsible and sustainable digital asset creation, paving the way for future developments in the blockchain ecosystem.

articleTitle: Exploration of integrating sustainable development goals into interdisciplinary communication courses
publicationTitle: IET International Conference on Engineering Technologies and Applications (ICETA 2024)
abstract: In response to the international situation, climate change, and the impact of limited energy resources, countries have seen a rise in environmental awareness, leading to the emergence of green design and the circular economy. In 2015, the United Nations identified major global issues and proposed the Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs), which encompass economic, social, and environmental dimensions. These 17 goals are to be reviewed in 2030 to assess the progress and actions taken by countries. Taiwan is also facing various changes and developed the "Taiwan Sustainable Development Goals" in 2019 to align with international sustainable development trends. Education crucial role in cultivating core knowledge, attitudes, and skills in students. Building on this foundation, this st udy aims to implement SDGs in communication courses and explore the feasibility and impact of integrating SDGs into university- level communication curricula. The experimental process was divided into two phases. The first phase involved 111 students from the Department of Mass Communication, while the second phase included 58 students from 11 different colleges, representing diverse interdisciplinary backgrounds. The experimental results indicated that: (1) Over 68% of the participants used social networks for more than 3 hours daily; (2) Instagram was the most used social media platform (over 91%), followed by YouTube (over 87%) and Line (over 84%); (3) The most viewed content type was "entertainment" (over 91%), followed by "lifestyle" (over 69%) and "knowledge" (over 47%); (4) The impact of communication courses on SDGs development focused on "interdisciplinary integration," "digital revolution," and "circular economy" as the top three areas. Media is not only a tool for creating awareness of the SDGs but also plays a crucial role in the communication process, becoming a pillar in building a socially sustainable development. Strengthening the promotion of sustainable development education through school education is essential not only for environmental awareness but also for enabling people to make informed decisions that achieve environmental integrity, economic feasibility, and social justice and soundness.

articleTitle: Enhancement of single channel speech using perceptual convolutional neural networks
publicationTitle: IET International Conference on Engineering Technologies and Applications (ICETA 2024)
abstract: The noise of machines is annoying and can cause permanent hearing damage when working in a noise-disturbing environment for an extended period. It is essential to reduce factory noise effectively so frontline workers can avoid hearing damage. This study aims to reduce factory noise by masking the critical frequency spectrum through auditory perception and convolutional neural networks to reduce interfering noises and retain speech signals. The experimental results show that the proposed method can effectively remove the interference noise and that the speech quality is good. We hope the proposed system can be developed into a practical noise-reduction headset to save factory workers from noise interference.

articleTitle: Robust control of non-holonomic constraint robot trajectory tracking based on cerebellar model articulation controller
publicationTitle: IET International Conference on Engineering Technologies and Applications (ICETA 2024)
abstract: This research is based on the application of new theories in wheeled robot trajectory following. The trajectory following control method in the system is implemented using a hybrid controller, as for the track slip and resistance parts, the external disturbance estimator (disturbance observer) is used to complete. The hybrid controller consists of two parts. The first part uses Kinematics and Dynamics equations to form a basic controller. The basic controller is designed to reduce trajectory tracking errors. The second part of the controller consists of the Cerebellar Model Articulation Controller (CMAC), which uses intelligent methods to assist the first part of the controller to resist the internal uncertainty and parameter variance of the wheeled robot. The slippage and resistance of the mission ground cause external interference to the wheeled robot. An external disturbance estimator (disturbance observer) combined with a hybrid controller is used to reduce external interference in the trajectory tracking of the wheeled robot. The purpose of using a hybrid controller combined with an external disturbance estimator in this paper is to enable the wheeled robot to resist internal uncertainty and reduce the influence of external interference when performing a trajectory tracking task, and to complete a robust task in which the real trajectory is consistent with the expected trajectory. Supplemented by Matlab /Simulink simulation verifies the new theoretical integrity and feasibility of the hybrid controller.

articleTitle: Automatic resource recycling classification system
publicationTitle: IET International Conference on Engineering Technologies and Applications (ICETA 2024)
abstract: This research aims to design an automated waste sorting system to support the goal of sustainable development . This system uses embedded sensors and image recognition technology to identify types of waste and automatically classify them into corresponding recycling bins. This not only simplifies the process of waste sorting, reducing manpower costs and environmental pollution, but also improves recycling rates. This innovative technology is expected to advance the modernization of waste management and have a positive impact on our environment.

articleTitle: Two-step authentication: multi-biometric system using voice and facial recognition
publicationTitle: IET International Conference on Engineering Technologies and Applications (ICETA 2024)
abstract: The proposed study presents an authentication system integrating facial and voice recognition technologies to enhance authentication in a small group with camera and microphone, providing a solution focused on cost-effectiveness. Through practical implementation and rigorous testing, this project demonstrates the effective integration of diverse biometric modalities, offering security and usability. The face recognition model and voice recognition model serve an efficient accuracy. The voice verification process can contain a real-time authentication procedure that aids in double authentication security by employing random words as CAPTCHAs in the future. The code and models are publicly available at<uri xlink:href="https://github.com/NCUE-EE-AIAL/Two-step-Authentication-Multi-biometric-System" xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">https://github.com/NCUE-EE-AIAL/Two-step-Authentication-Multi-biometric-System</uri>.

articleTitle: Advances in AI for fraud detection
publicationTitle: IET International Conference on Engineering Technologies and Applications (ICETA 2024)
abstract: Fraud detection is a critical task across various industries, and the emergence of artificial intelligence (AI) techniques has revolutionized the field. This paper provides a comprehensive technical review of recent advances in AI-based fraud detection methods. We explore how machine learning, deep learning, and other AI techniques are reshaping fraud detection approaches, discussing their strengths, limitations, and real-world applications. Additionally, we examine key challenges and future directions in leveraging AI for fraud detection.

articleTitle: A traffic sign recognition system design for road safety assistance
publicationTitle: IET International Conference on Engineering Technologies and Applications (ICETA 2024)
abstract: This article outlines the design of a traffic sign image recognition system for road safety assistance. Initially, we used YOLOv7, a computer vision technology based on neural networks, to train an image recognition model on standard traffic sign images in Taiwan. Next, we developed a mobile app using C# and the Unity software development tool and integrated the trained model. This app turns the mobile phone into a road sign image recognition system, providing essential traffic sign information for drivers and visually impaired pedestrians to enhance traffic safety. The article also presents our progress in image training and the real-world performance of the recognition system.

articleTitle: Super-resolution for traffic signs: a comparative analysis of SRGAN and ESRGAN performance
publicationTitle: IET International Conference on Engineering Technologies and Applications (ICETA 2024)
abstract: Super-resolution technology improves the quality of images and videos by enhancing details and overall clarity. Although many pre-trained super-resolution models are available, they are generally designed for general use. This research aims to investigate using existing SRGAN and ESRGAN models to enhance the quality of traffic signs through retraining from scratch. Based on the PSNR metric, our experiment showed that SRGAN and ESRGAN effectively improved image quality, achieving scores of 29.838 and 29.503, respectively. These results indicate the potential of customizing pre-trained super-resolution models for specific tasks, which could significantly enhance the accuracy and effectiveness of traffic sign detection systems.

articleTitle: YOLO app on road markings for safer driving
publicationTitle: IET International Conference on Engineering Technologies and Applications (ICETA 2024)
abstract: Traffic accidents in Taichung City have increased steadily over the past five years, attributed to rising numbers of cars and motorcycles, leading to higher accident and violation rates. Violations related to specific road markings are a significant factor. This study uses the advanced YOLOv8 object detection model to classify road markings in detail. The model will be trained on a dataset of 9,225 Taiwanese road photos, including 4,839 day images and 4,386 night images. The trained model will be exported as a TFlite model and integrated into Android Studio to develop an app capable of operating on roads day and night.

articleTitle: Stability analysis of a hybrid wind/PV Farm connected to a multimachine power system through an HVDC link based on a modular multilevel converter
publicationTitle: IET International Conference on Engineering Technologies and Applications (ICETA 2024)
abstract: This paper presents the stability-analysis results of a hybrid renewable-energy farm (HREF) connected to the IEEE 14-bus multimachine power system (MMPS) through a high-voltage direct-current (HVDC) link based on a modular multilevel converter (MMC). The HRES consists of a wind farm based on a doubly-fed induction generator (DFIG) and a PV farm based on a PV array. A voltage-source inverter (VSI) using a grid-forming (GFM) control scheme in the PV farm is proposed to mitigate the impact of the lack of inertial support using a grid-following (GFL) control scheme. For small-signal stability analysis, the root-loci plots of the studied system using the GFL and the GFM control strategies are compared. The transient results of the studied system subject to an islanding condition using the GFM and the GFL control strategies are also compared. The simulation results indicate that the studied system using the GFM control scheme demonstrates better damping performance on the HREF than the GFL control scheme.

articleTitle: Development of a BPNN-based portable motor status diagnosis device
publicationTitle: IET International Conference on Engineering Technologies and Applications (ICETA 2024)
abstract: Motors are frequently used in both everyday and industrial settings. Besides manual assessment, monitoring devices are commonly employed to evaluate motor status. Typically, these monitoring devices are fixed to the motor bearings or housing, which can pose challenges for motors that need to be frequently moved. Therefore, this study develops a portable motor status diagnosis device based on Backpropagation Neural Network (BPNN) to enhance the flexibility of data measurement and accommodate a wider range of applications. The training and experimental results of the network model demonstrated a reduction in the loss rate from 68% to 25.6%, and an improvement in prediction accuracy from 8% to 74.31%.

articleTitle: Cell segmentation in fluorescence microscopy images
publicationTitle: IET International Conference on Engineering Technologies and Applications (ICETA 2024)
abstract: For microscopic cells images, cells’ morphologies are widely varied among different imaging modalities and staining methods. For fluorescence microscopy images, Poisson noises present in images due to the lightening, causing photobleaching, which makes it challenging in analysis with the deep learning models. Traditionally, median filtering can be applied to the original image for denoising, however, it also results in a blurry image, which is harmful to segmentation. In this study, the Haar Wavelet Transform is used to alleviate the photobleaching problem for cell segmentation, integrated to the framework without interfering with feature extraction by the backbone model. For our experiments, instance segmentation for fluorescence-stained cells was performed based on U-Net architecture with the method of gradient flow tracking proposed by Cellpose. And the Haar wavelet downsampling is embedded in the skip connections to verify if it can improve the segmentation performance for fluorescence images. The experimental results show that the approach of Haar wavelet downsampling embedded in the skip connections achieve superior performance among the other settings. Compared with the performance of the baseline model, the performance of the proposed model reached 0.732 in F1-score, which surpassed the one of baseline model (0.6341) by almost 0.1.

articleTitle: Stability improvement of renewable energy sources connected to a multi-terminal high-voltage direct-current link based on a modular multilevel converter
publicationTitle: IET International Conference on Engineering Technologies and Applications (ICETA 2024)
abstract: This paper investigates the stability of a multi-terminal high-voltage direct current (MTHVDC) link based on a modular multilevel converter (MMC) by connecting an offshore wind farm (OWF) and an ocean thermal energy conversion (OTEC) system to two power grids. The study addresses low-frequency oscillations in the studied system and designs damping controllers for the MMC of the MTHVDC link. The performance of these damping controllers under system disturbances is validated using dynamic time-domain simulations. The simulation results show that the stability of the studied system can be effectively improved by the designed damping controllers located at the MMC of the MTHVDC link under various disturbance conditions.

articleTitle: Advanced security approach for building secure containerized manufacturing digital twins
publicationTitle: IET International Conference on Engineering Technologies and Applications (ICETA 2024)
abstract: In the era of digital transformation, containerized systems and digital twins are vital technologies in intelligent manufacturing. Our previous research, the Implementation Framework of Digital Twins for Intelligent Manufacturing (IF-DTiM), lacks comprehensive security features[1]. To address this critical gap, we propose the Advanced Security Approach for Building Secure Containerized Manufacturing Digital Twins (ASABS-CMDT), integrating automated tools for detecting vulnerabilities, container image creation, and secure digital signing, all within DevSecOps practices. Case studies show that ASABS-CMDT significantly enhances system security and reduces development time, offering valuable insights for practitioners in intelligent manufacturing.

articleTitle: Communicative and management strategies in innovative teaching: exploring and analyzing key elements in prompting teachers and students to become societal practitioners
publicationTitle: IET International Conference on Engineering Technologies and Applications (ICETA 2024)
abstract: This study aims to explore the application and action research of the dual PBL (Project-Based Learning) teaching method, the USR (University Social Responsibility) practice project, and communication management in inspiring students to participate in social practice and contribute to SDGs (Sustainable Development Goals) issues. To verify students' learning effectiveness and understand their awareness process of the entire action research, this study employs focus group interviews and participant observation to conduct dyadic research on the two main subjects of social practice: "community—local residents" and "school—students." Through interpretative analysis, three main propositions were derived: (1) guiding students through communication to transform knowledge into practical skills can achieve seamless integration of knowledge and life; (2) empowering teachers and students through innovative communication techniques and field participation in social practice enhances their social resilience; (3) co-learning and co-construction under communication improve the effectiveness of cross-disciplinary autonomous learning and enhance the effectiveness of participation in social practice.

articleTitle: Emotion recognition using self-attention convolutional neural network for interactive learning system
publicationTitle: IET International Conference on Engineering Technologies and Applications (ICETA 2024)
abstract: In learning emotion recognition, existing models focus on recognizing seven commonly used emotions. Because of the high confusion level of emotions, the recognition difficulty is very high, resulting in unsatisfactory recognition results. In thi s study, we focus on recognizing learning emotions in the interactive learning process to recognize the learning emotion and improve the recognition effect. We utilize the self-attention mechanism with the convolutional neural network (SA-CNN) to improve the model's ability to recognize emotional features. The system understands the learner's real-time emotional state by integrating this improved model into an AI-innovated Virtual English Learning (AIiVEL) system. The AIiVEL system can remind the learner appropriately when the learner's state is not good and also serve as a basis for adjusting the progress of the teaching content appropriately. The experimental results show that this system recognizes the learning emotion effectively, and it can be applied to the AIiVEL system.

articleTitle: Implementation of telecontrol and telemetry systems in robots for monitoring in all terrains
publicationTitle: IET International Conference on Engineering Technologies and Applications (ICETA 2024)
abstract: This paper presents a remotely controlled robot developed utilizing telemetry and telecontrol techniques that serves as a monitoring system. This robot can effectively send Attitude and Heading Reference System data and analyze the data using the Direction Cosine Matrix (DCM) approach to determine the robot's position by using an IMU (Inertial Measurement Unit) sensor. Additionally, equipped with an IP camera, this robot can show real-time streaming video based on its environmental conditions. This paper produces a robot that increases efficiency and effectiveness while helping people remotely do monitoring tasks. Based on the test results, position testing is conducted 0–5 meters away, and the average drift on the x-axis was 0.20707 meters and on the y-axis was 0.405 meters. At the same time, testing of the telecontrol and telemetry systems developed in this research worked smoothly at a distance of 20 meters with 100% data reliability quality.

articleTitle: Bottom tuyere monitoring and warning system for basic oxygen furnace steelmaking
publicationTitle: IET International Conference on Engineering Technologies and Applications (ICETA 2024)
abstract: This paper described how to developed a monitoring and warning system for bottom tuyeres of basic oxygen furnace. The system integrates multiple detection functionalities and is customized to meet the requirements of the steelmaking process environment. Its main thermal image processing functions include automatic detection of bottom tuyere position, acquisition of designated area data, multi-region synchronization analysis, abnormal status warning, etc. Based on the completed thermal imaging detection capabilities, the system can be expanded to all temperature monitoring environments within the steelmaking plant, thereby enhancing the overall utility and impact of the proposed system.

articleTitle: Enhancing poultry farm production through intelligent manufacturing technologies
publicationTitle: IET International Conference on Engineering Technologies and Applications (ICETA 2024)
abstract: This study explores the integration of smart and intelligent manufacturing technologies in poultry farming to enhance production efficiency, reduce operational costs, and improve overall farm management. The study discusses various strategies such as data analytics, automated feeding systems, health monitoring, robotics, supply chain optimization, energy efficiency, quality control, and artificial intelligence. These technologies aim to revolutionize traditional poultry farming practices, providing farmers to optimize resource utilization, enhance decision-making processes, and ensure the well-being of the flock.

articleTitle: Implementation of hearing impaired assistive system using visual aids
publicationTitle: IET International Conference on Engineering Technologies and Applications (ICETA 2024)
abstract: Although hearing aids have been developed for decades, they can still not address the hearing-impaired person's impairment, mainly because the amplified noise makes hearing-impaired people uncomfortable. How to help hearing-impaired people communicate with ordinary people is still an urgent need. In this study, we aim to realize a system that combines speech recognition and speech segment detection to recognize speech and display the recognition result in the smart glasses so that the hearing-impaired person can see the content of the other person's speech through the smart glasses, and the experimental results show that the system realized in this paper can improve the ability of the hearing-impaired person's ability to converse with the other person.

articleTitle: IoT-based intelligent aquaponics system
publicationTitle: IET International Conference on Engineering Technologies and Applications (ICETA 2024)
abstract: This system is based on aquaponics, integrating Arduino and IoT technology for interactive and intelligent monitoring via a mobile app. Users can download expert parameters to enhance crop survival and quality. The power supply system alternates between solar panels and rechargeable batteries, ensuring stable power and achieving green energy conservation. It enhances agricultural productivity, promotes interaction with nature, improves quality of life, implements innovative agriculture management, and advances agriculture towards efficiency and sustainability.

articleTitle: Progressive latent fusion mapper for hairstyle transfer
publicationTitle: IET International Conference on Engineering Technologies and Applications (ICETA 2024)
abstract: In recent years, with the rapid development of deep learning and basic hardware equipment, hairstyle transfer technology used to simulate different hairstyles and hair colors has made significant breakthroughs. However, current hairstyle transfer techniques still face challenges in retaining user identity and background information, as well as dealing with complex computations, which create obstacles in generating high-quality images. To address the aforementioned issues, this study proposes a progressive latent fusion mapper (PLF-Mapper) constructed with spinal linear layers for hairstyle transfer research. This method processes the embedding features through the spinal linear layers within the mapper, thereby extracting more accurate hair attribute features and precisely capturing the complex textures and structures of hairstyles. According to experimental results, the PLF-Mapper proposed in this study demonstrates excellent model transferability on the CelebA-HQ public database. Compared to previous studies, it has fewer model parameters, lower computational complexity, and better FID scores, achieving values of 1.57M, 188.93M, and 38.54, respectively.

articleTitle: Investigating the brain connectivity signatures of inner peace
publicationTitle: IET International Conference on Engineering Technologies and Applications (ICETA 2024)
abstract: The concept of peace is central to human well-being, yet its neural substrates remain largely unexplored. This paper investigates the peacefulness of brain connectivity, aiming to elucidate the neural mechanisms underlying subjective feelings of tranquility and serenity. Through a review of existing literature and neuroscientific findings, this study explores the role of various brain regions and networks in promoting states of peace. Additionally, it discusses methodological approaches, such as functional magnetic resonance imaging (fMRI) and electroencephalography (EEG), that have been utilized to investigate brain connectivity during peaceful states. The paper proposed directions for research in this emerging field, including the integration of bioinformatics and machine learning techniques to unravel the complex dynamics of peaceful brain connectivity. Our analysis focused on identifying specific patterns of brain connectivity that are characteristic of peaceful states. We employed machine learning algorithms, network analysis techniques, and statistical modeling to analyze the EEG and fMRI data and extract meaningful insights. The results reveal distinct patterns of functional connectivity within and between brain regions that are associated with feelings of peace. These findings contribute to our understanding of the neural basis of peace and have implications for mental health research and interventions aimed at promoting well-being.

articleTitle: Evaluating the impact of eye-tracking technology on simulated takeoff and landing flight training
publicationTitle: IET International Conference on Engineering Technologies and Applications (ICETA 2024)
abstract: Eye movement data can be utilized to observe attention distribution, offering valuable insights into how flight cadets engage with their environment and their underlying cognitive processes. This study evaluates the impact of eye-tracking technology on simulated takeoff and landing flight training. The experiment involved two simulated flights, with eye-tracking data provided to the experimental group between sessions. Results indicated significant improvements in the experimental group’s flight performance, particularly in attention allocation to critical instruments, evidenced by decreased deviations in altitude, speed, and heading. This suggests that eye-tracking data can enhance training effectiveness by providing cadets with insights into their visual attention patterns, thereby improving decision-making and learning outcomes.

articleTitle: Enhancing edge computing in high-density IoT for improved service quality and privacy protection
publicationTitle: IET International Conference on Engineering Technologies and Applications (ICETA 2024)
abstract: This study aims to enhance edge computing in high-density user environments by reducing the computational burden on edge nodes and improving service quality. With advancements in 5G technology, networks are evolving towards high-density IoT landscapes. Edge computing offers low-latency services by placing small servers close to users; however, increasing users can negatively impact service quality. The study integrates privacy protection measures to address this issue and utilizes user devices to assist edge computing. During large gatherings, an excessive number of users can overwhelm edge servers. The system can dynamically adjust service capacity by incorporating user devices, improving overall service quality.

articleTitle: A study on the sensationalism of APP news alerts in Taiwan
publicationTitle: IET International Conference on Engineering Technologies and Applications (ICETA 2024)
abstract: This study adopts sensationalism as the theoretical framework to explore the content characteristics of six mainstream news media's APP alerts in Taiwan. The study randomly selected 24 days with 9,683 news alerts in 2023 as a sample, and the results show that social and political news is the leading news subject, and text and punctuation are the primary formats. The most used pragmatic function in APP news alerts is 'direct quotations' and 'questions' to entice the audience's curiosity. Academic research has paid less attention to app news push notifications, yet app management holds significant importance for media traffic and revenue. Moreover, through the lens of sensationalism theory, this study can provide valuable insights for future communication policy planning for emerging platforms, thereby keeping the audience well informed.

articleTitle: The development of technology applications in teaching
publicationTitle: IET International Conference on Engineering Technologies and Applications (ICETA 2024)
abstract: The development of technology has changed human life and, at the same time, education and teaching methods. The development and application of technology in education are explained one by one. In the face of the emergence of communication technologies in each stage, such as multimedia teaching materials, digital learning, online teaching, AI, and other related technologies, how to assist in teaching and teaching methods to improve student's learning effectiveness is the primary motivation and direction of this article.

articleTitle: A dual-loop CDR circuit with dual-mode capacitor multiplier-based loop filter and active inductor ring VCO
publicationTitle: IET International Conference on Engineering Technologies and Applications (ICETA 2024)
abstract: This paper proposes A half-rate dual-loop clock and data recovery (CDR) circuit with dual-mode capacitor multiplier-based active loop filter and active inductor ring voltage controlled oscillators (VCO). The proposed capacitor multiplier-based active filter allows for changing the operational mode of the CDR circuit to adjust the loop bandwidth, thereby enhancing stability and reducing required area. The improved active inductor ring VCO features a wide tuning range and low power consumption. The proposed CDR is implemented in the 90 nm CMOS technology. The simulation results show that the rms jitter and the peak-to-peak jitter of the recovered data is 5.3ps and 31.1ps at 2.7-Gb/s data rate. For the recovered clock, the rms jitter and peak-to-peak jitter are 5.1ps and 28ps at 1.35 GHz clock frequency. This work consumes 11.2mW with 1.2V power supply.

articleTitle: Using asymmetric surface relief gratings to unify the efficiency in certain field of view for see-through display
publicationTitle: IET International Conference on Engineering Technologies and Applications (ICETA 2024)
abstract: This paper designs a planar waveguide structure for light coupling and decoupling used in near-eye see-through AR displays. The light coupling mechanism employed in this study is an inclined Surface Relief Grating (SRG) structure. The designs of the coupling and decoupling ends are different, allowing for uniform light intensity within a specific field of view. The SRG can be fabricated using common molding techniques and utilizes high-refractive-index materials commonly used in AR displays. Numerical simulations using the Finite Element Method (FEM) fully demonstrate the diffraction properties of the light.

articleTitle: Effect of different arc angle of machine tool supports on the geometric accuracy of the base
publicationTitle: IET International Conference on Engineering Technologies and Applications (ICETA 2024)
abstract: Machine tool supports are primarily used to support the overall weight of machine tools and maintain the machine's level. The arc angle design a of the machine tool supports affect the geometric accuracy of base. Therefore, this study uses finite element analysis software to investigate the effects of different arc designs and fastening sequences of machine tool supports on the overall machine and the contact surface of the machine tool supports fastening, as well as the overall levelness of the machine.

articleTitle: Comparative stability analysis of a DC microgrid connected to the simplified Taiwan power system using grid following inverters and grid forming inverters
publicationTitle: IET International Conference on Engineering Technologies and Applications (ICETA 2024)
abstract: This paper presents the comparative stability of a DC microgrid (MG) connected to a multimachine power system (MMPS) using grid-following inverters (GFL) and grid-forming inverters (GFM). The studied DC MG includes a wave power generation system, a biomass power generation system, and a supercapacitor (SC)-based energy storage system (ESS). Based on the virtual synchronous generator (VSG), the control strategy based on the GFM is adopted to suppress the deviations of the active power, the DC-link voltage, and the AC frequency of the studied system. The differences between using the GFL and the GFM of the studied system before and after the introduction of the virtual inertial control are compared. Comparative dynamic simulations of the studied system using the GFL and the GFM of the studied system are also performed.

articleTitle: Enhancing exercise engagement through AI-driven virtual training and game-based animation
publicationTitle: IET International Conference on Engineering Technologies and Applications (ICETA 2024)
abstract: This study investigated if using an animated game screen and a virtual trainer enhances engagement in repetitive exercises during fitness training. It involved 21 participants randomly assigned to two groups: one performing unaided physical exercise and the other exercising with a virtual trainer and playing "Pong". Participants rated their exercise enjoyment using the Physical Activity Enjoyment Scale (PACES) and wore sports smartwatches to monitor heart rhythm and caloric expenditure. Results showed that participants using the virtual coach and dynamic game screen exhibited significantly higher interest in exercise based on PACES scores (p < 0.05).

articleTitle: Drag-reducing testing set-up for biomimetic functional surfaces
publicationTitle: IET International Conference on Engineering Technologies and Applications (ICETA 2024)
abstract: Due to the increasing fuel consumption of shipping year by year, a functional surface coating with less drag force is one of the solutions to reduce the carbon emission of marine vehicles. In this study, a self-made drag-reduction testing system was established to compare the drag-reducing effects of two types of bio-inspired coatings along with samples without coatings in flowing water. The results indicate that the self-made drag-reduction testing system can indeed distinguish drag differences among samples with various microstructures. This testing set-up could provide a simple route for basic drag reduction measurement of coatings in the future.

articleTitle: Assessing one-hot encoding in predictive models for public transportation systems — a case study of commuting behaviour analysis
publicationTitle: IET International Conference on Engineering Technologies and Applications (ICETA 2024)
abstract: To achieve efficient and effective prediction of public transportation traffic volume, this study proposes using chi-square tests to analyze attributes with significant differences. Subsequently, data is generated for these attributes using one-hot encoding (OHE) and then inputted into a deep learning model for traffic volume prediction. The results of this study indicate that even when applying OHE to attributes with significant differences, the improvement in model performance is limited. Therefore, as long as the deep learning model has sufficient capability to learn from time series data, OHE may not be necessary.

articleTitle: A second-order noise shaping SAR ADC with 8x fully passive gain circuit technique
publicationTitle: IET International Conference on Engineering Technologies and Applications (ICETA 2024)
abstract: This paper presents a 14-bit second-order fully passive noise-shaping successive approximation register analog-to-digital converter using capacitors and switches to perform a passive integrator. It employs two prior circuit techniques: embedded passive gain and passive signal residue summation. A circuit technique of signal charge redistribution is proposed to reduce the noise and area costs of the comparator and capacitor. Therefore, the zero of the noise transfer function can be improved with an efficient solution. This work achieves SNDR of 87.3dB with a bandwidth of 260kHz at an oversampling ratio of 16. It consumes only 96.6μW of power under a supply voltage of 1V using the 90-nm CMOS technology. The Schreier FoM would reach 182 dB.

articleTitle: Implementation of an automatic skin disease identification system using convolutional neural network for scabies in long-term care facility residents
publicationTitle: IET International Conference on Engineering Technologies and Applications (ICETA 2024)
abstract: Scabies are the most common infectious skin disease among residents of long-term care facilities. The outbreak of infection is often difficult to control. Sarcoptes scabies cause scabies, which spread rapidly in people in close contact with each other. Due to the lack of healthcare professionals in long-term care facilities, the lack of dermatologic knowledge and recognition skills of scabies among frontline caregivers make it challenging to detect scabies infections early. In this study, we implement an automatic scabies identification system using a webcam or cell phone lens to capture images of residents' skin in long-term care facilities and then use a deep-learning convolutional neural network to identify scabies automatically. The experimental results show that the proposed system can accurately and quickly identify scabies and can be applied to long-term care facilities.

articleTitle: Numerical simulation analysis on electromagnetic effect of offshore wind power 1 by 8 array
publicationTitle: IET International Conference on Engineering Technologies and Applications (ICETA 2024)
abstract: This study has utilized numerical simulation tools to analyze the electromagnetic field characteristics of offshore wind turb ines arranged in a 1x8 array. The focus is on the initial investigation of the electromagnetic field distribution of a 6MW offshore wind turbine at L band radar frequencies. The integration of technology has enabled the intelligent prediction of the electromagnetic effects of wind turbines in array configurations. The numerical electric field distribution has revealed shadow areas (corresponding to radar scan blind spots). These simulation results can be incorporated into navigation control mitigation measures to ensure the normal operation of radar systems in offshore wind farms.

articleTitle: LSTM neural network for current prediction and harmonic analysis in solar power system
publicationTitle: IET International Conference on Engineering Technologies and Applications (ICETA 2024)
abstract: Distributed energy resources (DERs) are increasingly integrated with the power grid, affecting its operation, stability, and reliability. This decentralized generation influences the performance of traditional power plants and dispatch centres. In this study, we use a multi-input Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) neural network to monitor power quality and process data. MATLAB software is employed to predict waveforms, and the results demonstrate the LSTM model's ability to accurately predict current and harmonic variations in solar power generation across varying weather conditions.

articleTitle: Implementing OPC UA architecture using open62541
publicationTitle: IET International Conference on Engineering Technologies and Applications (ICETA 2024)
abstract: In the field of industrial automation, the diversity of products and protocols poses significant challenges for system integration. OPC UA (Open Platform Communications Unified Architecture) is a standardized communication protocol that aims to unify and support interoperability among various systems and devices. This paper explores the applications and challenges of Open62541 in implementing OPC UA. It discusses the implementation of the server/client and publish/subscribe communication models within OPC UA. By comparing these communication models, this paper provides insights into their respective advantages and limitations. Ultimately, Open62541 offers a reliable and flexible solution for addressing system integration issues in industrial automation.

articleTitle: Artificial Intelligence in education
publicationTitle: IET International Conference on Engineering Technologies and Applications (ICETA 2024)
abstract: The integration of Artificial Intelligence (AI) into education has the potential to revolutionize traditional learning methodologies, offering personalized learning experiences, optimizing administrative tasks, and enabling educators to make data-driven decisions. This paper provides a comprehensive review of the current landscape of AI in education, covering various applications such as intelligent tutoring systems, personalized learning platforms, automated grading systems, and educational analytics. Additionally, it discusses the challenges and ethical considerations associated with the implementation of AI in education and explores future prospects and trends in this rapidly evolving field.

articleTitle: Development of intelligent shape meter system
publicationTitle: IET International Conference on Engineering Technologies and Applications (ICETA 2024)
abstract: This paper primarily focuses on developing an "Intelligent Shape Meter System, ISMS" for the hot-dip galvanizing line, which integrates historical production data and various online process parameters. By incorporating machine learning algorithms powered by artificial intelligence, it translates the data database and the relationship between the bending force of the temper mill into an AI mathematical model, establishing the "Dynamic Rolling Force Prediction Model." This allows for real-time prediction of the bending force values in the temper mill, enabling immediate feedback for automatic flatness adjustment. As a result, the average monthly edge wave rejection rate decreased from 0.24% before the system's implementation to 0.07%.

articleTitle: A study on the impact of college students’ motivation for using new technology media on their media literacy skills
publicationTitle: IET International Conference on Engineering Technologies and Applications (ICETA 2024)
abstract: This study explores the impact of motivations for using new technology media on developing media literacy skills. The results indicate that mobile phones serve as the carriers for using new technology media and that the motivation for using new technology media affects media literacy skills.

articleTitle: Integrating attention mechanism to establish lightweight YOLOV4 wine bottle defect detection model
publicationTitle: IET International Conference on Engineering Technologies and Applications (ICETA 2024)
abstract: This article proposes a wine bottle defect detection method that integrates attention mechanism with YOLOv4 Tiny pre training model. The model addresses the uneven texture, size, and number of categories of wine bottle defects, and focuses on the significant features of wine bottle surface and bottle cap defects in the neural network. Ultimately, good detection results are achieved, with precision, recall, and mAP (mean average precision) reaching 88.67%, 91.20%, and 93.65%, respectively, in YOLOv4 tiny ECANet's network model.

articleTitle: Voltage stability improvement of multi-microgrid clusters using unified power flow controllers
publicationTitle: IET International Conference on Engineering Technologies and Applications (ICETA 2024)
abstract: This paper investigates the voltage-stability improvement of bus nodes within four microgrids (MGs) clusters based on the IEEE 14-bus test system using unified power flow controllers (UPFCs). Wind and solar power generation systems are integrated into the studied four MGs as renewable energy sources (RESs) to simulate practical power-system conditions. At the same time, electric-vehicle (EV) loads are added to the load side of the studied four MGs. The UPFCs are introduced into the transmission lines between nearby MGs to enhance the voltage stability of the proposed architecture. An examination of the static voltage stability of the studied system is first performed. The characteristics of the studied system under various line-outage scenarios are observed through the system load margin and theP-Vcurves. For transmission line stability, a fast voltage stability index (FVSI) is proposed for assessment. Time-domain responses of the buses of the studied system under different line-outage scenarios are also achieved to explore the dynamic voltage stability.

articleTitle: The prototype design is based on IoT and integrates physiological information and gas monitoring alarms
publicationTitle: IET International Conference on Engineering Technologies and Applications (ICETA 2024)
abstract: Along with the popularity of Internet of Things (IoT), modern monitoring systems are broadly applied in various fields, particularly in the monitoring of underground pipeline. Personnel safety and the release of hazardous gases are two major risks in the operation of underground pipeline. Gas monitoring systems, through IoT, could detect the concentration of hazardous gases in pipeline to prevent and reduce the risks of thermal damage and hazardous gases leakage. Moreover, physiological information monitoring systems could monitor the physiological parameters of pipeline maintenance personnel and ensure their safety in dangerous environment. Such monitoring systems could be integrated with green energy to supply power, through renewable energy, for monitoring equipment, fulfilling better sustainable and environmental solutions. In summary, IoT integrated gas and physiological information monitoring systems could effectively prevent the harm of thermal damage and hazardous gases as well as enhance the application of green energy to enhance the operation security and sustainability of underground pipeline.

articleTitle: Titanium diffused lithium niobate grating for planar waveguide coupling
publicationTitle: IET International Conference on Engineering Technologies and Applications (ICETA 2024)
abstract: This study explores the feasibility of using Ti-diffused LiNbO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub>for fabricating gratings applicable to planar waveguides. Through numerical analysis, the diffusion concentration of Ti in LiNbO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub>and the resulting refractive index changes under various processing parameters were calculated. Additionally, the diffraction behavior of light was analyzed using the Finite Element Method. The results demonstrate that Ti-diffused LiNbO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub>can be effectively used for light coupling and transmission. The optimal processing parameters were found to be a diffusion temperature of 900°C and a diffusion time of 0.6 hours, with a diffraction efficiency of 42.84% achieved under conditions of DC=0.4 and τ=4μm. This study confirms the potential of Ti-diffused gratings applications and provides a promising alternative for future augmented reality display technologies.

articleTitle: Implementation of remote AI farmer system
publicationTitle: IET International Conference on Engineering Technologies and Applications (ICETA 2024)
abstract: People need to pay more attention to planting and caring for plants. Orchids are an essential potted flower item in the global flower market as they are a highly economical flower production crop. Despite the increasing demand for orchids in the global market, the production of orchids has remained the same, which is attributed to the difficulty in caring for orchids and the high cost of human efforts. Therefore, this study chooses orchids as the target. We realize an orchid care system that can give users precise advice on fertilizer and pesticide application through AI assistance. The automatic light chasing system allows orchids to chase the light when the light is weak and avoid the light when the sun is intense; the humidity detection gives orchids an automatic humidity environment; and the wireless photography and identification allows farms to be identified and managed automatically. The application of this system can also be extended to other species of plants. Accordingly, the proposed system is scalable.

articleTitle: Exploring teaching and marketing strategies for community inclusion: a case study of the Guantian circular economy
publicationTitle: IET International Conference on Engineering Technologies and Applications (ICETA 2024)
abstract: Guantian District, Tainan is the largest production place in Taiwan. The water caltrop shell waste, the by-product of growing water caltrop, is produced and weighs as much as 3,740 metric tons per year. It is not only hard to get rid of or to be treated but also poses environmental and air pollution problems. Thus, the project teaming up with the industry, the government, and the academics collectively developed Biochar, or the so-called Guantian Black Gold, which is approved by European Biochar Certificate (EBC) international patent system and International Biochsar Initiative (IBI). The water caltrop shell waste can now be transformed from waste to “black gold;” the project successfully solved the age-old community problems from the environmental, economic, and social perspectives.
